ctx.x: Yeah, they faded into -- some of them went into what they call the Off-Broadway shows and say, like with Eddie Cantor, Banjo Eyes, you know -- even Al Jolson, I mean he attempted to -- to get them in the pictures, moving pictures, see, and -- but he was so happy, you know, he married he and Ruby Keeler, I think it was, and what's that?
Excuse me, that was Al Jolson.
